description_en: Deletes a public key from the specified user
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost delete-user-public-key --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --public-key-id 11 --region cn-hangzhou
